capabilities: Collect Markdown tasks from all notes into a grouped view
Filter tasks by status, section name, and folder scope
Check tasks in the view to update the original notes
Defer or hide notes via frontmatter keys
Render the same grouped task view through a companion CLI
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the companion CLI reads the vault and the plugin's saved settings.
motivation: The author wants a global task list that feels like a normal Obsidian note, with headings, checkbox styling, and edits that update the original note.
problem: Obsidian tasks are scattered across notes, and there is no built-in global view that groups them while keeping the original notes as the source of truth.
summary: Task view plugin that gathers Markdown tasks from every vault note into one grouped list, with a companion CLI for scripts and AI agents.
